gymTitle: Our hotel gym is ready whenever your stay needs a reset.

gymLocationValue: Floor 1, next to the spa area
gymAccessValue: Included for guests with an active stay

gymEquipmentCardio: Treadmills, bikes, and ellipticals for cardio sessions
gymEquipmentStrength: Guided strength machines for major muscle groups
gymEquipmentFreeWeights: Dumbbells, an adjustable bench, and a free-weight training area
gymEquipmentRecovery: Space for stretching, mobility work, and post-workout recovery
gymRulesSubtitle: A few clear rules help keep the gym comfortable and safe for every guest.
gymRuleAccess: Gym access is reserved for guests with an active reservation or ongoing check-in stay.

gymRuleSafety: Wear appropriate sportswear and use equipment according to the posted instructions.
gymRuleHours: Respect the gym schedule and leave each station clean after use.
gymZoneStrengthDescription: Essential machines, free weights, and a layout designed for more focused training sessions.
gymZoneRecoveryDescription: A calmer corner for stretching, mobility work, and winding down after training.
spaTitle: Our spa is designed for slow recovery, warm water, and quiet moments between plans.
spaSubtitle: The SPA area is available to hotel guests and complements the stay with hydrotherapy, sauna warmth, and calm lounge time.
spaAccessValue: Included for guests with an active stay
spaAccessTitle: The spa is part of the hotel stay experience

spaAccessUpcomingTitle: Your spa access starts at check-in

spaBenefitHydro: Hydrotherapy pool for light recovery and low-stimulation relaxation
spaBenefitSauna: Sauna access for heat sessions and a deeper reset
spaBenefitLounge: Lounge seating for pauses between spa sessions
spaBenefitAtmosphere: Quiet ambient lighting and a slower, restorative pace

spaRuleSchedule: Respect the daily schedule and any temporary capacity guidance from the front desk.
spaRuleWellness: Use the facilities responsibly and choose shorter sessions if you are sensitive to heat or humidity.
